operations.summary: refuse an error message in a product's source that says a failure happened without saying which, against a baseline that only shrinks

causes.cause: line {line} says {quoted_sentence}, which {reason}, and the baseline allows {allowed} of it in this file while it holds {held}
causes.remedy: declare the cause and raise it, saying what failed, why, the state observed and what fixes it, in place of the sentence

causes.cause: the baseline allows {allowed} of {quoted_sentence} in the file while it holds {held}, and a baseline only shrinks
causes.remedy: lower the entry for {path} in {baseline} to {held}

operations.summary: hold the failure catalogue a product prints to the declaration rules, its tests, the values its raising sites pass and the entries it has

causes.cause: {count} of its declarations break a rule, each named on its own line below
causes.remedy: change each declaration as its line says, then run the check again

causes.failed: holding {operation}.{cause_id} to the values its raising sites pass
causes.cause: `{field}` names {placeholder}, and no raising site in {repository} passes a value of that name, so every reader would see {placeholder} as written
causes.observed: {sites} source file(s) read; value names passed: {passed}
causes.remedy: pass {name} where the cause is raised, or take {placeholder} out of `{field}`

causes.cause: {why}, and {untested} does not list it with the reason it cannot be provoked locally
causes.remedy: write that test, name the one that provokes the cause, or list {test} in {untested} with why no local state can provoke it

causes.cause: entry {position} is not a test path with a reason: it holds {found}

causes.failed: matching the entries in {entries} to the declared functionalities
causes.cause: the entry {quoted_entry} starts no declared functionality, so whoever meets its failures has no declaration to read
causes.remedy: declare every functionality it runs and name {quoted_entry} in their entries

operations.summary: hold the warnings a product prints to the declaration rules, their tests and one warning for every confirmation

causes.cause: {count} of its warning declarations break a rule, each named on its own line
causes.remedy: change each declaration as its line says, then run the check again

causes.failed: matching the confirmations in {confirmations} to the declared warnings
causes.cause: the entry {quoted_entry} asks for a confirmation, but no functionality it starts declares what the confirmation is for
causes.remedy: declare the warning, or stop asking for a confirmation nothing needs

operations.summary: list every line of a consuming tree that writes an envelope key by hand instead of building the envelope with this package

causes.failed: reading {files} source file(s) under {roots} for hand-built envelopes
causes.cause: {count} line(s) write failure_point or error_code outside the package, so their derived fields can drift from the catalogue
causes.remedy: build each envelope with wisent-errors; a log line already parsed, a field declaration or another API's own error_code is a reason to keep the line, and reading it decides which
